results.title: Resistivity drop at point of use
results.text: A sudden fall in resistivity downstream of the polishing stage, with normal resistivity at the EDI outlet, points to the mixed-bed polishing resin. Compare resin runtime with its rated life. A gradual fall that follows rising RO permeate conductivity points upstream to the RO stage instead.

results.title: AMC rising in a process bay
results.text: Compare AMC at the make-up air inlet with AMC in the bay. If the inlet is steady while the bay rises, the chemical filtration stage is the likely source.

results.title: Mixed-bed polishing resin exhaustion
results.text: Exhausted ion-exchange resin lets ions break through, so resistivity drops quickly. Corrective action: replace or regenerate the resin bed, flush to rinse down, and verify resistivity recovers toward the limit before returning the loop to service.

report.narrative: An investigation was conducted for the resistivity excursion at asset POU_LITHO_1 where the measured resistivity dropped to 18.0311 MOhm.cm against the limit of 18.2 MOhm.cm (E1, E2). The sensor calibration is valid (E1). Upstream tracing shows that RO_A and POLISH_A precede the loop (E7). Runtime data indicates that the RO membrane has exceeded its rated life at 26400 hours and 110.0 percent of rated life (E10), while the polishing resin is at 2100 hours and 46.7 percent of rated life (E8). Furthermore, RO permeate conductivity sensor UPW_A_COND_RO shows a rising trend up to 4.4597 uS/cm (E12), whereas the EDI outlet resistivity remains stable near 18.0825 MOhm.cm (E11). According to knowledge base article UPW-03, a gradual fall that follows rising RO permeate conductivity points upstream to the RO stage, ruling out mixed-bed polishing resin exhaustion. Therefore, qualified engineers should review the RO membrane degradation as the primary root cause.
recommended_actions: Recommend qualified engineer review of the RO_A membrane condition and plan for membrane replacement or cleaning since operating hours are at 26400 hours (110.0 percent of rated life).
Recommend qualified engineer verification of RO permeate conductivity sensor UPW_A_COND_RO and review of RO stage operating parameters.
